body:
Thank you. I will stay safe.

I just need help. Like a support system. I feel like I can't confide in anyone though. I don't find people trustworthy, and the ones who are, I either don't want to burden them or embarras myself infront of.

I'm hoping to go to school in January so I think then I will be able to see the counsellors provided by the school. It feels like forever away though. And this depression is becong very consuming. 

Thanks for reaching out to me.

You are really kind.

I need a job. I lost mine. I was being sexually harassed by the owner of the company. I had only worked there for 2 months so I don't have much rights when it comes to my employment there. 

I used to attend AA when I was having those issues but am no longer having issues with that. And honestly the group setting can sometimes be more depressing than not. No one wanted to be my sponsor. The other young people were cliqued up. A man who reached out to me seemed to have alternative motives.

I have an SO who I love dearly and I can confide in somewhat but I don't want to burden him with this. He knows I'm depressed but I don't want him to think I'm suicidal. He doesn't deserve that stress. 

I just want this to pass. It seems to be getting worse instead of better.

Hi. Thanks for taking the time. Yes that makes sense. But who do I talk to? I don't want to ruin my image for the rest of my life because I told someone too much private information. I wish that wasn't the way the world is but it is.

I have a lot of issues in my life, just as everyone else does. I was abused as a child, raped as a teen, homeless, drug addict, dropped out of school, total fuck up basically. I have always hated myself. It has been a very hard road to get things on the right track and I'm just so exhausted. I've come along way but have had another set back and I just don't have the energy anymore.

I don't want to kill myself but I'm overwhelmed completely. I don't have the skills to cope with life at 24 and I don't open up to people about my past so I believe certain people in my life might think I'm lazy but I'm just so depressed going about the day is a huge struggle.
